page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance trade-off between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores, which all rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, along with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, also consistently perform in the average tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to offset the lower single-core efficiency. The instance is suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, and static web serving. It is also capable of handling moderate LLM inference tasks for small to medium models, such as prompt processing and text generation for 135M and 7B parameter models, where it delivers average performance.
